name: Nashiro Momiji
source:
"Drama-Enthusiastic Girl Who Longs for the Stage (舞台に憧れる演劇少女)"

A classmate sitting next to the protagonist. 
Momiji is very interested in theater drama, after school she reads her favorite books aloud like it was script to practice.

Normally she appears to be absent-minded and a little clumsy, but is capable of completely surprising the surroundings with something she suddenly says. Her image completely changes when she stands on the stage, she appears very bold and dashing.

Momiji uses her favorite hair tie instead of a bookmarker.
